title: A board of two resistors and a header
how: Footprints in the file: R1, R2 and J1 = 3 components, with 2 pads each = 6 placed pads;
nets 1 and 2 are GND and SIG (net 0 is no net) = 2; pads with a net: R1.1, R1.2, R2.1, R2.2, J1.1 = 5 pad nets (J1.2 has none);
one `segment` = 1 track of 1 piece; one `via`; four `gr_line` on Edge.Cuts close a ring = 4 outline points; no zone;
the fields of the footprints are not silkscreen items, so none; the layers named F.Cu and B.Cu are the 2 copper layers;
the quality report keeps 3 components, 6 pads, 2 nets, 1 track, 1 via and 4 outline points and drops the `setup` list.
